---
title: "Fig. 1E/L and Supp. Fig. 2E - WT ring canal cell-count quantification"
output: null
date: "2026-06-17"
---

Code to graph and calculate manuscript summary values for Mendoza et al.,
Fig. 1E/L and Supplemental Fig. 2E.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggprism)
library(stringr)
source("analysis_helpers.R")
```

```{r}
data_file <- "../Data/Fig1E_L_SuppFig2E_WT_RC_cell_count_quantification.csv"
combined_output_file <- "../Results/Fig1E_WT_combined_RC_to_cell_ratio.pdf"
category_output_file <- "../Results/Fig1L_WT_RC_to_cell_ratio_by_marker.pdf"
pnut_output_file <- "../Results/SuppFig2E_WT_Pnut_among_Pav_Vsg_RCs.pdf"

wt_ring_counts <- read_analysis_csv(data_file)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 1E/L and Supp. Fig. 2E: calculate ring canal-to-cell ratios and
# collapse Pnut+ categories where needed for Pav/Vsg composition summaries.

wt_ring_counts <- wt_ring_counts %>%
  mutate(
    RC_to_Cell = RC_Count / Cell_Count,
    CombinedCategory = case_when(
      Category == "pav, pnut" ~ "pav",
      Category %in% c("pav, vsg, pnut", "vsg, pav") ~ "pav, vsg",
      TRUE ~ Category
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Fig. 1E: combine Pnut+ and Pnut- categories to compare Pav and Vsg ring
# canal classes.

wt_ring_counts_combined <- wt_ring_counts %>%
  group_by(`File name`, Replicate, CombinedCategory) %>%
  summarise(RC_to_Cell_Sum = sum(RC_to_Cell, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
# Fig. 1E: plot WT ring canal-to-cell ratios for Pav+, Pav+/Vsg+, and Vsg+
# categories after collapsing Pnut status.

plot_box_jitter(
  data = wt_ring_counts_combined,
  x = CombinedCategory,
  y = RC_to_Cell_Sum,
  plot_title = "Ring canal to cell ratio",
  x_labels = c("Pav+,Vsg-", "Pav+,Vsg+", "Pav-,Vsg+"),
  jitter_width = 0.15
)

ggsave(combined_output_file, width = 2.75, height = 2, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 1E: replicate-level summary values for the plotted ratios.

wt_ring_counts_combined %>%
  group_by(Replicate, CombinedCategory) %>%
  summarise(Replicate_Mean = mean(RC_to_Cell_Sum, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  summarize_mean_sd(group_cols = "CombinedCategory", value_col = Replicate_Mean)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 1L/manuscript: ring canal-to-cell ratios using figure-panel labels.

ring_ratio_by_replicate <- wt_ring_counts_combined %>%
  mutate(
    Measurement = recode(
      CombinedCategory,
      "pav" = "Pav+, Vsg-",
      "pav, vsg" = "Pav+, Vsg+",
      "vsg" = "Pav-, Vsg+"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Replicate, Measurement) %>%
  summarise(Replicate_Mean = mean(RC_to_Cell_Sum, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

summarize_mean_sd(
  ring_ratio_by_replicate,
  group_cols = "Measurement",
  value_col = Replicate_Mean
)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 1L: plot WT ring canal-to-cell ratios separated by marker combination.

wt_ring_counts_by_category <- wt_ring_counts %>%
  mutate(
    Category = factor(
      Category,
      levels = c("pav", "pav, pnut", "pav, vsg, pnut", "vsg, pav", "vsg")
    )
  )

plot_box_jitter(
  data = wt_ring_counts_by_category,
  x = Category,
  y = RC_to_Cell,
  plot_title = "Ring canal to cell ratio",
  x_label = NULL,
  x_labels = c("Pav+", "Pav+, Pnut+", "Pav+, Vsg+, Pnut+", "Pav+, Vsg+", "Vsg+"),
  jitter_width = 0.15
)

ggsave(category_output_file, width = 4.5, height = 3.5, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
# Supp. Fig. 2E: calculate Pav/Vsg overlap and Pnut positivity for each
# germarium/file.

ring_percent_by_file <- wt_ring_counts %>%
  group_by(`File name`, Replicate) %>%
  summarise(
    PavVsgTotal = sum(RC_Count[Category %in% c("vsg, pav", "pav, vsg, pnut")], na.rm = TRUE),
    PavVsgPnut = sum(RC_Count[Category == "pav, vsg, pnut"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Pnut_among_PavVsg = if_else(PavVsgTotal > 0, 100 * PavVsgPnut / PavVsgTotal, NA_real_)
  )
```

```{r}
# Supp. Fig. 2E: average file-level percentages within each replicate for the
# plotted distribution.

ring_percent_by_replicate <- ring_percent_by_file %>%
  group_by(Replicate) %>%
  summarise(
    Pnut_among_PavVsg = mean(Pnut_among_PavVsg, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# Supp. Fig. 2E/manuscript: percentages are pooled within each replicate, then
# summarized across replicates.

ring_percent_pooled_by_replicate <- wt_ring_counts %>%
  group_by(Replicate) %>%
  summarise(
    Pnut_among_PavVsg =
      100 * sum(RC_Count[Category == "pav, vsg, pnut"], na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(RC_Count[Category %in% c("vsg, pav", "pav, vsg, pnut")], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ring_percent_pooled_by_replicate %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Replicate,
    names_to = "Measurement",
    values_to = "ReplicatePercent"
  ) %>%
  summarize_mean_sd(group_cols = "Measurement", value_col = ReplicatePercent)
```

```{r}
# Plotting values: percentages are calculated for each germarium/file so the
# plot shows the distribution of individual samples.

ring_percent_by_replicate %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Replicate,
    names_to = "Measurement",
    values_to = "ReplicateMean"
  ) %>%
  summarize_mean_sd(group_cols = "Measurement", value_col = ReplicateMean)
```

```{r}
# Supp. Fig. 2E: prepare file-level percentages for plotting individual samples.

ring_percent_long <- ring_percent_by_file %>%
  select(`File name`, Replicate, Pnut_among_PavVsg) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(`File name`, Replicate),
    names_to = "Category",
    values_to = "Percent"
  )
```

```{r}
# Supp. Fig. 2E: plot the percentage of Pav+, Vsg- and Pav+, Vsg+ ring canals
# that are also Pnut+.

suppfig2e_plot <- plot_box_jitter(
  data = ring_percent_long,
  x = Category,
  y = Percent,
  y_labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1),
  y_limits = c(0,50),
  plot_title = "Percent that are Pnut+",
  x_labels = c("Pav+, Vsg+"),
  box_fill = "grey",
  jitter_width = 0.15
)

suppfig2e_plot

ggsave(
  pnut_output_file,
  plot = suppfig2e_plot,
  width = 2,
  height = 2.5,
  units = "in",
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```
